jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT DEPTHFIRST

We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world's software.

depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero-days vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software.

Our founding team includes deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and LLMs with technical leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We are looking for strong technical people who are interested in working at the intersection of AI, Security, and Infrastructure.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build AI-native security products for modern engineering and security teams. This is a high-ownership role for someone with sharp product instincts, strong technical judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product direction.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Research, Security, Design, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to shape product strategy and bring new capabilities from early customer signal to production. Depending on company priorities and your background, you may work on Agentic Pen-testing our Supply Chain security product suites.




YOU’RE EXCITED ABOUT THIS ROLE BECAUSE YOU WILL...

 - Own product areas end-to-end, from discovery through launch and iteration

 - Work directly with enterprise security and engineering teams to understand workflows, pain points, and success criteria

 - Translate ambiguous customer problems into crisp product bets

 - Partner with Engineering and Research to build agentic systems for discovery, triage, remediation, validation, and prevention

 - Build tight customer feedback loops to inform product decisions, trade-offs, and launches

 - Help build products that transform enterprise security programs




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Product management experience, or equivalent experience shipping technical products

 - Technical CS background through degree, software engineering work, or hands-on technical experience

 - Strong technical fluency with complex systems, APIs, data flows, and agentic workflows

 - Excellent product judgment and ability to prioritize durable customer problems

 - Strong written and verbal communication across technical and business teams

 - High agency in ambiguous, fast-changing environments

 - Located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco




BONUS POINTS FOR

 - Experience with application security, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, SAST, SCA, software supply chain security, or cloud security products

 - Background building products for security teams, developers, platform engineers, or technical enterprise buyers

 - Direct work with enterprise customers, especially security leaders, AppSec teams, or engineering leaders

 - Prior startup experience in a high-growth startup environment




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary with meaningful equity

 - Health, vision, and dental insurance

 - Office lunch and dinner (when working from our SF office)

 - High ownership and direct impact on product direction

 - The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and security



depthfirst is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

To all recruitment agencies: depthfirst does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to depthfirst employees. depthfirst is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT DEPTHFIRST

We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization - yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to solve security.

depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero-days vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software.

Our founding team includes deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and LLMs with technical leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We are looking for strong technically-minded people who are interested in working at the intersection of AI, Security and Infrastructure.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

depthfirst is hiring its first Product Marketing Lead. This is a founding go-to-market role for someone who wants to define how a category-defining security product is understood, talked about, and sold.

You will help define and iterate on positioning and messaging, and you will be the connective tissue between product, sales, and the market. The application security space is crowded and noisy, full of tools that overpromise, and your job is to make it obvious why depthfirst is revolutionary and better than the alternatives.

As the first PMM, you will wear many hats. You will write copy for our website, build sales decks, run product launches, lead sales enablement, and deliver competitive analysis. This is a broad, high-ownership role with room to build the function around you as we scale.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own positioning and messaging for depthfirst and each product, and keep it sharp as the product and market evolve

 - Make depthfirst stand out in a crowded, hype-heavy security market by turning technical differentiation into a clear, credible story buyers trust

 - Run product launches end to end: narrative, assets, timing, and cross-functional coordination across product, sales, and demand gen

 - Build competitor intelligence into a durable asset: track the landscape, run win/loss analysis, and equip the team with battlecards and objection handling that actually get used

 - Partner closely with sales to build enablement that moves deals, including pitch decks, one-pagers, demo narratives, and talk tracks, and sit in on calls to keep it grounded in reality

 - Write and own high-impact website copy that converts, from the homepage to product pages

 - Develop a deep understanding of our buyers and translate their problems into language that resonates across our website, pitch decks, one pagers, and enablement collateral

 - Feed market and competitive signal back to product to shape roadmap and priorities
   
   


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in product marketing, ideally including a first or early PMM hire at a fast-growing startup where you had to iterate on messaging

 - A track record of making technical products stand out in competitive, crowded markets

 - Strong partnership with sales, with real experience building enablement that reps rely on and win/loss or competitive programs that influence deals

 - Excellent writing: you can take something technical and make it clear, sharp, and persuasive

 - Comfort going deep on a technical product; developer tools, security, or infrastructure experience is a strong plus

 - High ownership and range: you are energized by owning many things at once and building from zero

 - Alignment with our mission of securing the world’s software

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary with meaningful equity

 - Health, vision, and dental insurance

 - 401k

 - Office lunch and dinner (SF office)

 - Ownership and significant room to grow as the company scales
